name: 7969-batchdecode-dsv2litefp8-1gpu
model: yiliu4/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat-Block-wise-FP8-Test-Only -- 16.1 GB over 4 safetensors shards, ungated, weights stored fp8 e4m3 in 128x128 blocks. Labelled `Test-Only` by its producer with no published accuracy, so the generated text is not a health signal.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 27 layers, 16 attention heads, hidden 2048, MLA, 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, fp8 e4m3 blockwise weights with bf16 compute.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 960 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: 256 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens, both with stdev 0, seed 42. `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` are set through `backend.extras.body`.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one H100, drafting 512-token replies from short prompts for 32 concurrent users.
launch:
model-path: yiliu4/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat-Block-wise-FP8-Test-Only

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules and its tokenizer needs them.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1
attention-backend: fa3
disable-radix-cache: true

# HAZARD: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions, and the device-side request table is
# (max requests) x (context length + 8) int32 -- at the advertised window that is terabytes and the
# server never starts. 4096 is the native window and the longest request here is 256 + 512 = 768.
context-length: 4096

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
